teaser: 'Which one do you actually need?' the clerk asks, holding two nearly identical boxes of screws toward you in the hardware store aisle. You already know, though you let the question sit a moment before answering. Life path 1 is the number of the builder who trusts a private read of things; INFJ is the type that studies a room before the hand ever moves. Crossed, this is someone who decides alone and quietly, then explains the decision only once, if asked twice, and only partly even then.
excerpt: Three cars ahead in the school pickup line, you rehearse what needs saying at dinner, revising it again before anyone has even come through the door.
